scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-the-coastal-fort-shanetz-the-bloc.story: A 295 km round trip from Kronstadt - roughly 5 h 05 in the saddle. The stops in between: Petrovsky, The Palace and Park Ensemble of the Villag, The Palace and Park Ensembles of the Town and The Blocade Ring. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.
